[/size][/b][i][b]XP HUD is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that displays a clean, centered XP bar on your HUD whenever you gain experience.
The goal of this mod is to enhance visual feedback without altering gameplay mechanics, keeping the experience immersive and true to Stardew Valley's original design.
[/b][/i]
[b][color=#ff7700][size=4] • Features •[/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=3]• Clean and centered XP bar display  
• Custom PNG skill icons  
• Color-coded skill names  
• Smooth fade-in / fade-out animation  
• Text shadow for improved readability  
• Supports SpaceCore custom skills  
• Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ (SMAPI 4+)

[i]This mod does not change game balance — it simply improves how experience gain is visually presented[/i].[/size][/b]
